Q1, Q2: the on-resistance at heat and at.why: the load's 84 mV and the charge's 13.9 mV are worked out at RDS(on) MAX at 25 C and VGS = 3 V; CSD17313Q2's datasheet gives no MAX above 25 C or under VGS = 3 V, and BQ29700DSER drives the gate to 3.4 V at the least only at a cell of 3.8 V, while the cell runs down to 2.75 V
Q1, Q2: the on-resistance at heat and at.source: TI SLUSBU9I, section 9.2.2, page 20: the total on-resistance takes the worst case of the FETs' on-resistance, its derating for temperature and the gate drive; CSD17313Q2 datasheet, SLPS260E, section 5.1, RDS(on) at VGS = 3 V, TYP and MAX, at 25 C, page 3; BQ297xx datasheet, SLUSBU9I, section 6.5, VOH of COUT and DOUT at BAT = 3.8 V, MIN, page 5; BQ297xx datasheet, SLUSBU9I, section 4, Device Comparison Table, BQ29700, UVP, page 3; BQ297xx datasheet, SLUSBU9I, section 6.6, VUVP, TA = 25 C, -50 mV to 50 mV, page 6

Q1, Q2: the discharge trip.why: under the typical 31 mohm, which CSD17313Q2's datasheet does not bound from below, the discharge trips over 1.85 A
Q1, Q2: the discharge trip.source: TI SLUSBU9I, section 9.2.2, page 19: the total on-resistance of the 2 FETs times the greatest discharge current stays under VOCD; TI SLUSBU9I, section 9.2.2, page 20: the total on-resistance times the greatest charge current stays under the OCC threshold; BQ297xx datasheet, SLUSBU9I, section 6.6, VOCD, TA = -40 C to 85 C, -15 mV to 15 mV, page 6; BQ297xx datasheet, SLUSBU9I, section 6.6, VOCC, TA = -40 C to 85 C, -15 mV to 15 mV, page 6; CSD17313Q2 datasheet, SLPS260E, section 5.1, RDS(on) at VGS = 3 V, TYP and MAX, at 25 C, page 3; the fixture's cell, made up for tests/boards: 2.5 V to 4.3 V, 0.5 A in charge, 3 A in discharge
